name: Kezar Stadium
summary: The Raiders began their inaugural 1960 season at Kezar Stadium before shifting their final three home contests to Candlestick Park.

homeRanges.note: Primary home at the start of the inaugural season.

name: Candlestick Park
summary: The Raiders moved their final three home games of 1960 to Candlestick Park and played their 1961 home schedule there.
sourceLabel: Las Vegas Raiders · Raiders vs. Patriots Through the Years

name: Frank Youell Field
summary: Frank Youell Field served as the Raiders' temporary Oakland home from 1962 through 1965 while the Oakland Coliseum was being developed.
sourceLabel: Las Vegas Raiders · Raiders vs. Patriots Through the Years

name: Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum
summary: The Coliseum opened as the Raiders' home in 1966, housed the first Oakland championship era through 1981, and again served as the franchise's home after the return from Los Angeles from 1995 through 2019.

name: Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum
summary: The Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum was the Raiders' home from 1982 through 1994, including the franchise's Super Bowl XVIII championship season.
sourceLabel: Las Vegas Raiders · Los Angeles Coliseum History

name: Allegiant Stadium
summary: Allegiant Stadium became the home of the Las Vegas Raiders beginning with the 2020 season. The enclosed stadium sits adjacent to the Las Vegas Strip.
